类 EntityDamageByBlockEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event

org.bukkit.event.entity.EntityDamageEvent
org.bukkit.event.entity.EntityDamageByBlockEvent
所有已实现的接口:
Cancellable
public class EntityDamageByBlockEvent extends EntityDamageEvent
当一个实体受到来自方块的伤害时触发该事件

原文： Called when an entity is damaged by a block

For explosions, the Block returned by getDamager() has already been cleared. See getDamagerBlockState() for a snapshot of the block if it has already been changed.

    • getDamagerBlockState

      @Nullable public @Nullable BlockState getDamagerBlockState()
      返回使玩家受到伤害的方块的已捕获 BlockState.

      原文： Returns the captured BlockState of the block that damaged the player.

      This block state is not placed so BlockState.isPlaced() will be false.

      返回:
      方块状态

      原文：the block state
